items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgzNzQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--85d7f1c565dad12a0a3f3ad8a2e9946cf4745708/Anuncio_cuadrado.png)

**¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!**

La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad.

Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura.

¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**!

**AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA**

Durante el evento se realizarán fotografías y grabaciones de video que podrán ser utilizadas por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión institucional.

Al participar, aceptas el uso de tu imagen conforme a lo establecido en nuestro Aviso de Privacidad.

📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

**Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026!**

The Guelaguetza is much more than just a celebration — it is the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that defines this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community.

And what better way to express this connection than through Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we are not only showcasing skill and dexterity, but also the ability to unite around a shared challenge, regardless of our background or culture.

Don’t miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We’ll see you at **Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2026**!

**NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY**

Photographs and video recordings will take place during the event and may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotional, documentation, and outreach purposes.

By attending, you consent to the use of your image in accordance with our Privacy Notice.

📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information:
#日本一を決めよう。
2026年度日本チャンピオンを決める国内最大の大会です。
FMCを除く、WCA公式競技16種目を開催します。
FMC競技については、別日に開催します。こちらよりお申し込みください。
[Japan FMC Championship 2026] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/JapanFMCChampionship2026)

本大会の決勝ラウンドにはWCA規則[9p2b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b)を適用し、最低50%の日本国籍の競技者が決勝戦に進出します。

主催: Japan Championship 2026 実行委員会
後援: 一般社団法人スピードキュービングジャパン
協力: 大阪キューブ会 / くるくる会

This competition will determine the **2026 Japan National Champion**.

**Important: Language Requirement**
This competition is held to determine the National Champion of Japan. Please note that all proceedings, announcements, and interactions with judges will be conducted exclusively in Japanese. Please be advised that we cannot accommodate personal interpreters within the competition area.

In accordance with WCA Regulation [9p2b](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p2b), a nationality quota will be applied to the final rounds of this competition. For all final rounds, at least 50% of the finalists shall represent Japan.

Organized by: Japan Championship 2026 Organizing Committee
Supported by: Speedcubing Japan
In cooperation with: Osaka Cube / Kurukuru Kai

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkxNDk2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a0320ff2edda2a566a44a345621b962503bdf392/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-06-10%20at%2015.21.39.jpeg)

Dicas:
- Este será um evento sem taxas de inscrições, só realize sua inscrição se tiver a certeza que irá comparecer.
- Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará;
- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado;
- Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição;
- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados.
- Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato.
- Cada competidor pode levar, no máximo, um acompanhante.

Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
Procure se divertir bastante!

Tips:
- This event has no registration fees; only register if you are certain you will attend.
- Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in;
- The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition;
- You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition;
- If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates.
- By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition.
- Each competitor may bring a maximum of one companion.

Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers.
Have fun!!
